ideas.name: Floppy Disk Archive
ideas.problem: Preserving legacy data and software from obsolete media like floppy disks is a significant technical challenge for archivists, developers, and enthusiasts. This app simplifies the process of identifying, cataloging, and potentially emulating floppy disk contents.
ideas.monetization: One-time purchase for advanced scanning and emulation tools ($29.99), with optional cloud storage plans for archived data.
